issues.on_page: Operating transfers in 86,000 / out (86,000) in fund columns, offset in the Eliminations column; Total Governmental Funds column blank
issues.issue: Transfers between governmental funds (General 40,000 and Road and Bridge 46,000 out; Road Sinking 46,000 and Other Governmental 40,000 in) are recorded as null because the Total column eliminates them. The identity still holds, but other county reports record gross transfers in and out. This is a consistency choice.
The Inheritance Fund's 'Taxes' is called inheritance tax only because of the fund name. Exhibit A's tax breakdown (p1) has no inheritance line, so the type is an assumption.
